releases.summary: Adds the Logger core app and improves first-run setup/start ergonomics.

databaseMigrations.summary: Logger app creates its own tables on first use.

changes: Adds Logger as a core installed app for viewing configured log files across Doki targets.
Runs setup inside the php-app container so host PHP extensions no longer block setup.
Improves start.sh and setup.sh Docker/Compose checks and startup guidance.
Refreshes README setup order to start Doki before running setup.
operatorNotes: Run ./setup.sh after ./start.sh to refresh runtime state and health checks.
No destructive changes are declared for this release.

releases.summary: Initial Doki release baseline from main.
changes: Establishes the first release baseline for Doki updates.
Includes Doki admin, apps, workflows, sources, onboarding, and schema version 17.
operatorNotes: Installs without release metadata should be treated as 1.0.0 by the updater.
